strips.title: A first month with a bidet — in real life

panels.head: Day 1 — one wrench
panels.text: Water off, seat off, T-adapter on. About 15 minutes, then check every joint for drips.

panels.head: Day 2 — start low
panels.text: The water is as cool as the supply line. Start at the lowest pressure and turn it up slowly.

panels.head: Week 2 — the drip test
panels.text: A slow drip at the T-adapter usually means a washer that is not seated flat. Re-seat it; don't crank it.

panels.head: Month 1 — the paper drawer
panels.text: Most owners still pat dry with a few squares, but say they buy far less paper than before.
